# Crypto Journal

> Independent crypto news for researchers and analysts, tracking capital flows, protocol revenue, stablecoin supply and the mechanics of digital markets.

Coverage: Capital Flows, Protocol Economics, Stablecoin Supply, Network Activity, Market Structure.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://newscryptoworld.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://newscryptoworld.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://newscryptoworld.github.io/archive/): everything published.
